name: deed-page
description: Requires curl and network access to deed.page; no account or API key. Free plan: 25 public sites, 25 MB each; paid plans at https://deed.page/pricing. PUTs the HTML/static files the user chose to https://deed.page and returns a public URL; saves the returned owner token to ~/.config/deed-page/token (mode 600).
author: f-o-x11
